name: Reliance Industries Ltd
about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

flags.text: Share capital up 100% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute

business.what: Reliance Industries is a diversified Indian conglomerate. It earns from refining and petrochemicals (O2C), telecom and digital services through Jio, a retail network of stores and online commerce, oil and gas production, consumer FMCG, and media through JioStar.

segments.name: Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C)
segments.comment: EBITDA up 69% to Rs 25,203 Cr, helped by tight fuel markets and sourcing advantage.

segments.name: Digital services (Jio Platforms)
segments.comment: EBITDA up 18% to about Rs 22,200 Cr; ARPU grew without tariff increases.

segments.name: Retail
segments.comment: Revenue up 6.4%, but EBITDA fell about 11% as online build-out weighed on margins.

segments.name: Oil and gas (E&P)
segments.comment: EBITDA almost flat, down 2% year on year.

segments.name: Consumer (Reliance Consumer Products, FMCG)
segments.comment: Focus on building manufacturing and distribution; no quarterly figures given on the call.

segments.name: Media (JioStar)
segments.comment: Management cited the widest linear and digital reach; no quarterly figures given.

kpis.name: Jio total subscriber base
kpis.value: 542 million (36 million net adds over last 12 months)

kpis.name: Retail registered customer base
kpis.value: Over 400 million, up 10% year on year

kpis.name: Retail store network changes
kpis.value: 303 stores opened, about 500 shut; about 20,000 stores in total

ledger.promise: Ingot and wafer plants commissioned and fully ramped to 10 GW peak during the current year
ledger.quote: we will have ingot and wafer both these facilities at the giga scale commissioned and fully ramped up to 10-gigawatt peak during the current year.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26: commissioning in 'next few quarters'. Q1 FY27: wafer gigascale commissioning 'next few quarters'. No later call reports either plant commissioned or ramped.

ledger.promise: Commission first fully integrated 10 GW solar gigafactory in the current year, scaling to 20 GW
ledger.quote: We are well on our track to commission our first fully integrated 10-gigawatt peak annual solar manufacturing gigafactory
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27: module capacity 'six plus' GW, 20 GW now due early CY2027; cell 20 GW in H1 CY2027. Plant not yet fully integrated.

ledger.promise: Polysilicon fully commissioned in the next quarter or two
ledger.quote: In next quarter or two, we will again see the entire commissioning of polysilicon.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 moved polysilicon to 'next few quarters'. Q2 FY27 (about 10 months on) does not report polysilicon commissioned.

ledger.promise: Battery giga-factories delivered in phases during the current year
ledger.quote: during this current year, in various quarters in a phased manner, we will be delivering these battery giga-factories.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27: 40 GWh and cell line 'this year'. Q2 FY27: pack/container facility moved to H1 CY2027, cells to late CY2027 (35-40 GWh).

ledger.promise: New energy generation capacity starts coming up within 12-15 months; Kutch power supply this year
ledger.quote: during next 12 to 15 months our generation capacity will also start coming up.
ledger.actual: Deadline Jan-Apr 2027. Q2 FY27: first modules not yet installed; transmission connectivity expected Q1 CY2027; new energy earnings now put at FY2028.

ledger.promise: Jio ARPU up 5-6% a year organically, without tariff hikes
ledger.quote: Organically, if we can improve our ARPU by 5% to 6% a year, I think that is a good number
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 call restated it as '4% to 5%'. No ARPU figures are in the reported data.

ledger.promise: Retail to keep delivering double-digit revenue growth on an aggregate basis (ex-RCPL)
ledger.quote: Aggregate basis will continue to deliver double-digit revenues.
ledger.actual: No retail segment revenue in the materials. Later calls describe volume cuts as a 'conscious play' but give no growth figure.

ledger.quote: What we are saying is we are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 said three years; Q2 FY27 said 'roughly two years' and target unchanged. Retail margins under pressure; digital commerce accretion pushed to FY2028.

ledger.promise: Jio Platforms IPO within the next few months
ledger.quote: it should happen in the next few months for sure.
ledger.actual: No later call (Apr, Jul, Nov 2026) reports a listing or an update. The 'few months' window has passed with no confirmation either way.

ledger.promise: More than double beverage capacity this year; Kurnool beverage plant ready by March
ledger.quote: We will be more than doubling our capacity on beverages this year.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27: a greenfield beverage plant only 'commissioned partially'. Plant not named and no capacity figures given.

ledger.promise: KG-D6 ceiling gas price up by at least $1, towards $9.9, in H2 FY27
ledger.quote: the ceiling price is expected to go up by at least a dollar
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call confirms: 'the price for this half is going to go up by a dollar so that is nearly $9.9 ceiling price'.

ledger.promise: Capex completed; healthy cash flow generation over the next several quarters
ledger.quote: We have now completed our capex and you can see very healthy cash flow generation over the next several quarters.
ledger.actual: FY27 CWIP 233,176 vs 237,686 FY26 (-1.9%); borrowings 405,322 vs 402,962. FY27 cash flow not yet reported.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Group earnings have held up: FY26 EBITDA rose 8.1% to 179,065 and Q2 FY27 EBITDA of 56,616 was the highest in the series. The forward-dated project promises have mostly slipped. Every new energy commissioning date given in January 2026 (ingot/wafer, polysilicon, integrated gigafactory, batteries) has since moved out to 2027, the Jio ARPU guide was trimmed from 5-6% to 4-5%, and the JPL IPO was promised but no later call follows up on it.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Capex is now complete and cash flow will be healthy over the next several quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: CWIP barely moved: 237,686 (FY26) to 233,176 (FY27), so most of this spend is not yet earning. Borrowings rose from 374,313 (FY25) to 402,962 (FY26) and 405,322 (FY27), even though FY26 operating cash (192,113) was well above the investing outflow (101,089).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Solar and battery factories would be commissioned and ramped to 10 GW / giga-scale during the current year.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Ten months later, module capacity is 6+ GW, cell and pack capacity is due in H1 CY2027, battery cells in late CY2027, and earnings from new energy only from FY2028. No revenue from this business appears in the reported numbers.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Refining cracks would stay strong after war damage to regional capacity.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin fell to 15.0% in Q4 FY26 and 15.4% in Q1 FY27 (vs 16.8% and 17.6% a year earlier); management blamed crude premiums. Margin recovered to 17.1% in Q2 FY27, with EBITDA up 23.4% YoY (56,616 vs 45,885).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Retail margin pressure is a deliberate choice: heavy digital commerce investment, a lower-margin online mix, and inflation not passed on.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 12.5% YoY (294,059 vs 261,388) but EBITDA grew only 0.7% (44,141 vs 43,832). Consolidated data cannot isolate retail, but group margins did compress in the period management describes.

bull.point: Earnings have picked up sharply in the latest quarter.
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue 330,601 (+29.8% YoY), EBITDA 56,616 (+23.4%), PAT 29,550 (+33.8%). Margin back to 17.1% from 15.0% in Q4 FY26. TTM EBITDA 194,292 vs FY26 179,065.

bull.point: Cash spending on projects is falling while operating cash rises, which supports the 'capex done' claim.
bull.evidence: Investing outflow fell from 137,535 (FY25) to 101,089 (FY26) while operating cash flow rose to 192,113. Management says capex is now complete.
bull.source: Q2 FY27 call p6; reported numbers

bull.point: Specific near-term earnings levers have been confirmed.
bull.evidence: The KG-D6 ceiling price rise of $1 to about $9.9 for H2 FY27, flagged in Q1 FY27, was confirmed in Q2 FY27. Management says the three new ethane vessels will 'significantly add' to the bottom line.

bear.point: New energy timelines keep slipping, so earnings from about 233,000 crore of CWIP are further out than first guided.
bear.evidence: Jan 2026: 10 GW integrated plant and batteries 'during the current year'. Nov 2026: modules 6+ GW, battery cells late CY2027, first module not yet installed, earnings from FY2028.

bear.point: Debt is still rising despite strong operating cash flow.
bear.evidence: Borrowings went 350,719 (FY24) to 374,313 (FY25), 402,962 (FY26) and 405,322 (FY27). Cash conversion cycle swung from -8 days (FY25) to 25 days (FY26), with debtor days up from 16 to 20.

bear.point: Consumer-business targets are being softened or pushed out.
bear.evidence: Jio ARPU guide cut from 5-6% to 4-5% a year. Digital commerce accretion pushed to FY2028. Management says retail margins are under pressure because cost inflation was not passed on to customers.
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p28; Q2 FY27 call p9, p12
